newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU jobless rate unchanged at 10.8 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: EU jobless rate unchanged at 10.8 pct in April.

text.p: European Union unemployment was unchanged at 10.8 percent in April, with 18.1 million people out of work, Eurostat, the EU's statistical office, said on Wednesday.
Following revisions, the latest result is the same as in March and little changed from April 1996 (10.9 percent) and the same month the previous year (10.7 percent).
Eurostat noted that the stubbornly high rate masked a steady decline in unemployment among people under 25 years old, which was down to 20.9 percent in April from 22.0 a year earlier.

Among the EU's 15 nations, joblessness over the past few months continued to rise in Sweden and Finland but fell in Britain, Ireland, the Netherlands and Spain. Elsewhere there was little change, Eurostat said.
Spain continued to have the highest level of unemployment at 20.9 percent while Luxembourg retained the lowest rate at 3.7 percent. Following are the April and March jobless rates for the EU.
